Free Entry for Asian Champions Trophy Hockey Matches Announced

Hockey India has announced free entry for all 20 matches of the Men's Asian Champions Trophy, scheduled to take place in Jalandhar and Mohali starting October 27. This decision applies to the 2026 tournament.
